summary_en: This study tests EIK1001 with pembrolizumab, compared with placebo with pembrolizumab, as first-line therapy for advanced melanoma. How EIK1001 is given, and how often, is not stated. The main outcome is not stated; this is a Phase 2/3 study.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa EIK1001 combinado con pembrolizumab, comparado con placebo más pembrolizumab, como tratamiento de primera línea para melanoma avanzado. El registro no indica cómo se administra EIK1001 ni con qué frecuencia. El registro no indica la medida principal de resultado; es un estudio de fase 2/3.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with stage 3 unresectable or stage 4 metastatic melanoma eligible for pembrolizumab.
Measurable disease on CT or MRI by RECIST 1.1.
Life expectancy of at least 3 months.
Known BRAF V600 status, or willing to have BRAF V600 testing.
not_for: Systemic therapy for advanced melanoma before the first study dose, with exceptions for adjuvant or neoadjuvant therapy.
Grade 3 or higher adverse event during prior anti-PD-1 therapy.
Known active brain metastases or carcinomatous meningitis.
Active autoimmune disease needing systemic treatment in the past 2 years, or chronic steroid or immunosuppressive use.
